verdict.rationale: Loops' 'agents' materials describe APIs/MCP/CLI/skills that let external coding agents (Claude, Cursor, etc.) act on Loops on the user's behalf — this is Loops being consumed by an agent, not a built-in AI assistant living inside the Loops product that a user delegates tasks to. No evidence of an in-app assistant (e.g., an AI chat/copilot embedded in the Loops dashboard) exists in the pack.
